subject: You’re invited to the Modwerk beta
body:
Hi,

I’d love to have you try the Modwerk beta. The tester pool is limited to 50 people.

Custom firmware can cause data loss or make your device unusable. Recovery is not guaranteed. Back up first.

[Join the beta]({{beta-invitation}})

Review the risks on Modwerk before joining. Afterwards, please join our development Discord to share feedback.

See you around,
Jannik
